title: React Todo App
description: Build a full CRUD todo application with React

steps.title: Setup Todo State
steps.description: Create a TodoApp component with a todos state array initialized to two sample items: { id: 1, text: 'Learn React', done: false } and { id: 2, text: 'Build a project', done: false }. Render each todo's text in a <li>.

verification.failureMessage: Make sure both sample todos appear in the list

steps.title: Add a Todo Form
steps.description: Add an input field and an 'Add' button above the list. Use a newTodo state for the input value. When clicked, add a new todo with the input text and a unique id. Clear the input after adding.
hints: Add button: <button onClick={() => { setTodos([...todos, { id: Date.now(), text: newTodo, done: false }]); setNewTodo(''); }}>Add</button>

verification.successMessage: Form renders with an input and button!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure you have an input and an Add button

steps.title: Toggle Done
steps.description: Add a click handler to each todo item that toggles the done property. Completed todos should show with a line-through text decoration.
hints: Use onClick={() => { const next = todos.map(t => t.id === todo.id ? { ...t, done: !t.done } : t); setTodos(next); }}

verification.failureMessage: Make sure clicking a todo toggles its done state

steps.title: Delete Todos
steps.description: Add a 'Delete' button next to each todo item. Clicking it removes that todo from the list.
hints: Filter out the deleted todo: setTodos(todos.filter(t => t.id !== id))

verification.failureMessage: Add a delete button to each todo item

steps.title: Filter Todos
steps.description: Add three filter buttons at the top: 'All', 'Active', and 'Completed'. Only show todos that match the selected filter. Track the filter with a filter state variable.
hints: Filter the list before mapping: const visible = todos.filter(t => filter === 'all' ? true : filter === 'active' ? !t.done : t.done);

verification.successMessage: Filter functionality works — you've built a full Todo App!
verification.failureMessage: Add filter buttons to show All/Active/Completed todos
